title: Boundaries appear at a consistent spatial scale

statements.text: Searches for field topologies matching reported experience will find them only at a broadly consistent spatial scale, which would also distinguish among electromagnetic theories of consciousness.
statements.falsification_criteria: Matching topologies appear at no consistent scale, or pulses that disrupt the identified topology leave the perspective intact.

sources.quote: We predict that such exercises will only identify topologies at a broadly consistent spatial scale
